cohort: 853 women with DM or PM, compared to a matched control group from the general obstetric population
finding: Women with DM or PM had a longer hospital stay and an increased risk of hypertensive disorders during pregnancy compared to the general obstetric population.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in the rates of cesarean section between patients with inflammatory myopathies and the control group.
country: United States (using the Nationwide Inpatient Sample)
